title: Builder Control — Agent Governance Registry
description: ONE workspace-level governance registry. Holds ZERO runtime/infra fields (no agentId, environmentId, memstoreId, cron, runtimeType). Those live ONLY in cornerstoneregroup-site/data/managed-agents-registry.json and are resolved via infraRef. Default-deny: an op not matched by allowedOps + allowedPathGlobs is blocked unless a task packet authorizes an exception.

infraRegistryPath.description: The ONLY home of runtime facts. Governance registry references it, never duplicates its fields.

agents.description: Keyed by canonical agent name (must match infra registry key when infraRef is set).

protectedPaths.description: Agent-scoped EXTRA protected paths, merged on top of the global protected-paths.json.

infraRef.description: Canonical key in managed-agents-registry.json, or null for non-infra agents (Claude Code / Codex local CLIs).

claude-code.role: Builder — scoped milestone implementation (BUILD-PROTOCOL Builder identity)
allowedTasks: implement scoped milestone from a task packet
forbiddenTasks: edit any path in protected-paths.json without packet authorization
git push to a public-repo path without authorization.allowsPublicPush
author customer-facing protocol content (Gold Standard build authors zero content in the orchestrator/builder)
invent dosing / schedules / evidence tiers from memory
claim completion without evidence in the same response

codex.role: Direct control-plane orchestrator for the Vitalis / Research Brain lane (DIRECT-AGENT-BYPASS-CONTROL-2026-06-18)
allowedTasks: route atomic tasks to bounded workers
forbiddenTasks: create a parallel Research Brain / scoring / dose / schedule engine when a canonical owner exists
external release without KRITE / Marc approval
use a North American government agency as customer-facing peptide-value authority

daniel.role: Research Intelligence Agent — weekly tool scout + research dossiers
allowedTasks: produce research dossier with T1-T4 tiering
emit weekly tool-scout markdown + JSON sidecar
forbiddenTasks: edit research-brain.json by hand instead of UPSERT through brain.js
requiredEvidence: scout JSON sidecar conforming to scout-diff.schema.json

krite.role: Compliance / content QA gate for customer-facing artifacts
forbiddenTasks: author protocol content it is reviewing
approve without running the content-contract audit

protocol-core.role: Curated canonical domain data (dosing / evidence / catalog / sources)
allowedTasks: serve canonical dosing/evidence/catalog/source data to consumers
forbiddenTasks: be edited by any agent without packet authorization (it is curated, not inferred)
sign off rendering quality as content/writing quality (independent systems)
